'''Bilikin Drell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Some guy! Said he was a Mandalorian! He got me the codes to break in. Said I could sell the names and make a fortune.|Bilikin Drell|<ref name="TOR:ADA" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Drell made a deal with [[Tarro Blood]] to steal the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt's]] target list and sell the names to the highest bidders in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. After Blood gave him the codes to break in, Bilikin was able to retrieve the list and held an auction on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. However, the competition's assistant Huntsmaster, [[Lek]], was able to send an [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified bounty hunter]] to retrieve the list.<ref name="TOR:ADA" />
{{GameDS}}
After a deadly fight, Drell begged the bounty hunter to spare him and promised that he would never speak the list again, but the hunter killed him for making a deal with Blood.<ref name="TOR:ADA" />
{{Endgame}}
